actual_cli_control.scope: Unmodified actual binary, fixed synthetic diagnostics; filter stdin versus wrap executing only printf in isolated cwd/state; not all wrapper branches.

findings: GenericHandler runs smart_filter before duplicate/template/relevance stages. RuntimeHandler also starts with smart_filter. Standalone filter stdin command does not stash its original input.
Actual binary filter command with two progress-shaped error diagnostics exits0 with empty stdout/stderr and no original blob. This qualifies the earlier direct-filter finding at this entry point.

Actual binary wrap running only fixed printf with the same diagnostics returns both original lines and exits0. The direct-filter data loss therefore does not establish full-wrapper data loss in this tested configuration.
CLI comparison uses isolated cwd/state and explicit builtin_filters=false, net_win_min_tokens=0. It qualifies one branch/configuration, not all wrapper behavior.

DSL layering gives project rules precedence over user rules and built-ins at equal name length; commands match literal prefixes. Tests exercise this through the real binary and owned project/state directories.
Filter DSL can intentionally drop/replace/truncate arbitrary text. It is presentation policy, not exact file comparison or lossless persistence.
transfer_decision: No implementation copied into rrrah. Candidate/presentation stages need their own stated guarantees and must not stand in for verified byte/pixel equality.
limits: 233 original focused tests and finite controls do not establish all filtering configurations, built-in rule correctness, wrapper integrity or all host integration.
